params.prompt: Original premium stylized hard-surface 3D game character design for KittyMech, an optimistic coastal repair-world co-op action game. One entire 4.5-meter bipedal feline industrial mech with one tiny adorable 0.5-meter adult housecat pilot clearly seated behind a small transparent protected cockpit in the upper torso. The pilot is a rounded cute kitty with simple plush fur, button nose and expressive ears; no human anatomy. Mechanically believable limbs with visible shoulder, elbow, hip, knee and ankle articulation; clear gaps for movement; hands and feet distinct from armor. Large clean ceramic/enamel armor panels over recessed dark plum mechanics, restrained metal edges, subtle service wear, high craftsmanship. Feline character through ear-shaped antenna fins, broad paw-inspired feet and face-like cockpit arrangement; no branded design, no text, no logo. Full body three-quarter front standing view at a near-orthographic 70mm perspective; both feet entirely in frame with generous margin, all major joints readable. Grounded lightly active pose, weapons lowered, neutral light warm-gray studio background and ground plane, soft daylight key and restrained rim light. Production concept render for later human modeling, sharp details, organized 3-level shape hierarchy, avoid tiny greebles, busy backgrounds, exploded parts, floating components, dramatic bloom, holograms, huge human eyes or extra limbs. Design A: POUNCE, an agile but weighty mid-range skirmisher. Athletic narrow-waisted silhouette, compact shoulders, tapered forearms, strong spring-ready thighs, broad but streamlined feet and twin compact rear calf thrusters, all still a straightforward biped joint layout. Ivory armor with bold burnt-orange forearm/shin panels and tiny teal signal lights; dark plum flexible recesses. One integrated short forearm pulse cannon on right arm; other articulated mechanical hand visible. Slight forward-ready attitude, powerful and nimble rather than spindly. Small ginger-and-white cat behind the clear cockpit, curious confident expression. Cat ears on the mech are short swept-back wedges. Primary design priority: unmistakably feline, visually legible from gameplay distance, controlled modular shapes that a small team can model.
